title: Gandugali Kumara Rama
desc: Kumararama, son of King Deva Raya, is exiled by his stepmother. However, he strives to overcome the challenges that life throws at him.

title: Raghu Thatha
desc: A wish to fulfil her terminally ill grandfather's last desire and her stance against patriarchy place Kayalvizhi Pandian between conflicting choices, as she struggles to make the right decision.

title: Mugulu Nage
desc: Pulakeshi is romantically involved with three women at different points in his life, which teaches him the meaning of love.

title: Kona
desc: Narayana and his prophetic robot discover a remote village bound by an age-old sacrificial rite. Soon, he uncovers a sinister secret trapping the villagers in an endless cycle of past and present.

title: Naanu Matthu Gunda
desc: Shankar, an autorickshaw driver, adopts an abandoned dog and names it Gunda. However, his life turns upside down when his affection for the canine deepens.
